name: Kate Waterhouse
story: Kate Waterhouse’s 2017 award submission records NZEUG executive committee service, two years as secretary, and organising the Rotorua 2016 and Tauranga 2017 regional user conferences. She also contributed to the NZGIS4EM emergency-management network. A 2018 practitioner paper names her in its account of developing geospatial capability and readiness for emergency response.
LINZ and the Geospatial Capability Committee included Kate Waterhouse in the Leaving School geospatial career-profile series: GIS Analyst, Bay of Plenty Regional Council, July 2018.
